title: Document scanner steps (/docs/scan) - part 1 of 3 (G-521..G-532; mainly document_scanner_screen.dart, router.dart, doc_scan_plan.dart)

guards.situation: A customer who is not logged in opens /docs/scan (deep link /app/docs/scan); the route itself is not login-protected, but every photo upload is refused without a session.
guards.old_where: lib/core/router.dart:174-193 (_authRequired does not list docs/docScan; same at 70a94933); lib/features/documents/document_provider.dart:491-495 (uploadDocPhoto returns not_authenticated when currentUser is null) -> lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:318-321 (_buildFailureReason -> scanSaveFailed)
guards.customer_sees: The scan runs, then the error overlay "Nepodařilo se přečíst" with the save-failed text; after 3 tries the "Pomůžeme vám osobně" contact overlay. No redirect to login.
guards.server: yes(save-verification-document and scan-document both call resolveDocCaller from _shared/auth.ts, 401 auth_required)
v2_where: lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:262 (same uploadDocPhoto call for both looks); lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:1034 -> _resultOverlayV2 :1128 -> lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:71 ScanResultV2
guards.verdict_evidence: The upload and the session check are shared code above the look branch; v2 only renders the same _resultMsg in ScanResultV2 with the "scan failed" heading and warn disc. Route guarding is router-level and identical in both looks.
guards.evidence: The upload and the session check are shared code above the look branch; v2 only renders the same _resultMsg in ScanResultV2 with the "scan failed" heading and warn disc. Route guarding is router-level and identical in both looks.

guards.situation: The customer leaves the scanner with the system back gesture or the header arrow at any time; there is no navigation lock (no PopScope) in either look, the route is wrapped in MgBackGuard so back never strands the customer.
guards.old_where: lib/core/router.dart:293-300 (MgBackGuard around DocumentScannerScreen); lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:217-223 (_safePop: pop or go /docs); lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:889-892 (_closeScanner disposes camera first); grep found no PopScope/WillPopScope in the scanner at 70a94933 or now
guards.customer_sees: Green back arrow top-left on every step; system back works.
v2_where: lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:1273 (_backBtn -> MgV2Back with the same onTap); lib/features/documents/v2/scan_camera_v2.dart:32 (ScanTopV2 back -> _closeScanner); lib/features/documents/v2/scan_choice_v2.dart:168 (ScanNightPageV2 back -> _safePop)
guards.verdict_evidence: All v2 back controls call the same _safePop/_closeScanner handlers; no extra exit path is added and no lock existed before.
guards.evidence: All v2 back controls call the same _safePop/_closeScanner handlers; no extra exit path is added and no lock existed before.

guards.situation: While the "only missing sides" plan loads, the customer cannot choose a document or start the camera; the load is capped at 20 s and falls back to the full flow if the status cannot be read.
guards.old_where: lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:701-703 (initState sets _planLoading and calls _loadPlan) :706-715; lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:759 (_loadingScreen, spinner + back); lib/features/documents/doc_scan_plan.dart:92-103 (20 s timeout, null status -> DocScanPlan.full via :36-37)
guards.customer_sees: Dark screen with header "Skenování dokladů", back arrow and a green spinner.
v2_where: lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:740 (ScanChoiceV2 loading:true, choices empty); lib/features/documents/v2/scan_choice_v2.dart:210-214 (skeleton rows only, no tappable choice)
guards.verdict_evidence: Both looks read the same _planLoading flag before anything else; the v2 loading view renders no choice rows (choices: const []), so nothing can be started early. In practice only v2 entry points send a missing mode.

guards.verdict_evidence: Same getter feeds both looks; v2 labels/counts use an identical filter.
